subject: SIG kickoff: clarifying SOC2 / data residency / SLA questions
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@finly.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T15:12:00Z
Subject: SIG kickoff: clarifying SOC2 / data residency / SLA questions

Hi Ethan,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the productive call. Quick recap and a small set of clarifying questions so our security team can scope the SIG/CAIQ/custom questionnaire properly: 

1) Compliance baseline: on the call you mentioned Finly has SOC 2 Type II in progress and a public GDPR program. Can you confirm whether SOC 2 Type II report is expected to be issued this year (ETA)?

2) Data residency & hosting: you said primary hosting is in AWS us-east-1 but may need EU residency for a portion of customers. Do you have a list of customers that require EU residency or is this evaluated on a per-deal basis?

3) PHI/PII handling: are you expecting Redwood to process PHI at launch? If yes, we’ll need to align on a BAA and required controls.

4) Questionnaire preference: would you like us to return the SIG (Standardized Information Gathering), an AICPA CAIQ, or fill a custom spreadsheet? We can support all three — SIG is usually fastest for initial review.

5) SLA / latency requirements: any hard SLOs (p50/p95), throughput estimates, or burst expectations we should include in the security/ops review?

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll attach a short SOC2 summary and our suggested SIG template for you to share with your security team.
- If you want the custom spreadsheet filled, please send it back; otherwise we’ll start the SIG prefill and return evidence placeholders within 3 business days.

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (summary of controls), SIG-template.docx (our preferred prefill)

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---

From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@finly.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T18:30:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff: clarifying SOC2 / data residency / SLA questions

Ben — thanks for the recap and for sending the template. Quick answers below: 

1) SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type II in progress with an expected issuance in Q4 2026 (estimate). We can share the pre-report and control matrix once available.

2) Hosting / residency: Primary hosting is AWS us-east-1. We do have a small subset (~8% revenue) of EU clients that require EU data residency; this is evaluated per-customer. For the POC with Redwood, they likely want US hosting, but we will confirm.

3) PHI/PII: We currently process PHI for certain customers (we are a healthcare payments company). We will need a BAA in place before any PHI flows to third parties.

4) Questionnaire: SIG + a short custom appendix would be ideal. We can send our intake spreadsheet if that helps.

5) SLA: For the pilots they expect p95 < 600ms for inference and a soft SLA of 99.9% monthly uptime; production SLAs will be negotiated if we move forward.

Attaching our security intake workbook (finly_security-intake.xlsx) which includes a short customer-specific appendix. Primary security contact: Olivia Chen (olivia.chen@finly.com).

We’d like to keep the timeline tight — is 2 weeks for SIG + BAA realistic?

— Ethan
Ethan Ross | Head of Security Integrations, Finly
ethan.ross@finly.com

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@finly.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff: clarifying SOC2 / data residency / SLA questions

Thanks Ethan — helpful. A few clarifying items so we scope evidence collection correctly: 

- PHI scope: can you confirm the PHI categories (e.g., patient identifiers, claim data, payment instruments)? We need to know whether PHI will be used as model input, returned in output, or stored.

- Expected volume: ballpark requests per minute during pilot and expected token volumes (if applicable) — this affects our batching/throughput recommendations and whether Dedicated capacity is needed.

- EU residency: if any EU customers will be in scope during the pilot, we’ll need clear routing rules. Otherwise default US hosting is fine.

Proposed SIG workflow from our side: 
1) We’ll prefill the SIG with our standard answers and flag items that require evidence.
2) We’ll produce an evidence map and hand off owners for each item (SOC2 doc, encryption configs, vulnerability scans).
3) For PHI we’ll produce a BAA draft and sample dataflow diagram for your legal/security teams to review.

Action items: 
- Ethan: send the customer appendix you mentioned (thanks for finly_security-intake.xlsx).
- Olivia: please confirm PHI categories and an internal owner for evidence collection (email to CC).
- Redwood: we’ll start a SIG prefill and return the prefilled SIG + evidence map in 3 business days. If you need the CAIQ instead we can flip to that.

Linking HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-8901

I’ll attach a short SOC2 summary excerpt for your security team (redwood_soc2-summary.pdf).

Best,
Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@finly.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T14:35:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff: clarifying SOC2 / data residency / SLA questions

Ethan — appreciate the intake workbook. Rapid note from product/security ops side: 

- If Finly needs EU residency for a non-trivial number of users we can support that via our Dedicated (region-pinned) offering; that will require a short architecture review and may add 2–3 weeks to provisioning.

- For PHI: Marcus (cc’d) will be the evidence owner for encryption, network controls, and BAA-related items. I’m attaching a draft BAA with our standard redlines (redwood_baa_draft.docx).

Marcus — please prepare an initial evidence map once Ben shares the prefilled SIG. Laura
Laura Bennett | Director, Customer Security & Trust
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@finly.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finly.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff: clarifying SOC2 / data residency / SLA questions

Thanks team — confirming next steps from our side: 

- We’ll proceed with SIG + a short custom appendix. Olivia Chen will be the internal owner for evidence and will coordinate with Marcus.
- PHI categories: primary are patient identifiers, claims metadata, and payment tokens. PHI will be provided as model input during the pilot but will not be stored by Finly beyond the duration of each session (we will provide retention details in the appendix).
- Volume: pilot expected ~50–120 requests/min peak; token sizes vary but are typically small (short text fields).
- Timeline: we’re aligned on target 2-week turnaround for SIG prefill + BAA review — Olivia will circle back with availability for evidence handoff this week.

Attaching our intake workbook and a short appendix (finly_security-intake.xlsx). Looking forward to the prefilled SIG.

Best,
Ethan
